04 — A FEW GOOD QUESTIONS

A little clarity.
Before you begin.

What if I’m completely new to training?+

That’s a perfectly good place to start. Your experience, confidence, and starting point help shape the plan. The first conversation is about finding what feels manageable for you.

Can I train from home?+

Online coaching can be planned around your space and the equipment you have. Session delivery, communication channels, and review frequency are agreed with your trainer before you sign up.

How often will I need to train?+

There is no one-size-fits-all schedule. Frequency is discussed around your goals, availability, and experience to build a routine you can sustain.

What does coaching cost?+

Pricing depends on your coaching format and frequency. The trainer will confirm the available options and full costs before you make any commitment.

Where do in-person sessions take place?+

The trainer will confirm locations and availability. These details haven’t been added to this demonstration website yet.
